title: Depth-labeled interpolation and substitution in Sacchetti's modal logics
summary: Classifies depth labelings in the modal logics wGL_n for positive n. Every simultaneous formula-valued substitution indexed by atom and depth label preserves theoremhood exactly when the labels satisfy c(k+n)=c(k) at every positive depth k. The interpolation equivalences identify the corresponding labeled property with its ordinary interpolation property and the same periodicity condition; the ordinary interpolation theorems remain explicit inputs.
